title: Master Engineering Coordinator — System Overview

t: Keyword Extraction — Turning Objectives into Queries

t: Delegation Stage 1 — The Knowledge Coordinator Is Asked First

t: Delegation Stage 2 — The Tool Registry Is Consulted

title: Honest Refusal — "build a warp drive"
description: Objectives outside the capability map are reported as proposed — never built, never faked.

t: Capability Map — The Four Build Patterns

t: Usage Guide — Give It an Objective, Read the Report
description: The report always contains the objective, per-stage results with statuses, and the final outcome.

title: Limits — Deterministic Orchestrator, Not General Intelligence
t: Limits — Deterministic Orchestrator, Not General Intelligence
description: The master matches patterns; it does not reason, learn, or invent new engineering approaches.

t: Integration Map — How the Five Systems Connect
